name: Dragon Stronghold
description: The undersea plane where the Scarzam dragons make their lair and where Sivitri sparked.

description_citations.text: "Sivitri Scarzam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As a young Corondor girl, Sivitri attempts to drown herself but instead sparks to the Dragon Stronghold.
timeline.quote: One day she attempted to drown herself, but instead sparked to the Dragon Stronghold.

citation.text: "Sivitri Scarzam", section "Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Dragon Stronghold Sivitri learns of her draconic ancestry, masters hydromancy and cold magic, and forges armor, saddle and bridle before returning to invade Corondor.
timeline.quote: Sivitri learned of her draconic ancestry.

citation.text: "Sivitri Scarzam", section "The Dragon Stronghold". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
